atlases.name: Lodjuret
atlases.detail: Selected G1 LODJURET, the grey-brown anthro Nordic lynx in the supplied reference: black long ear tufts, warm hazel eyes, cream chin, short lynx muzzle and black nose, grey-brown spotted fur and cheek ruffs. Plain charcoal unfastened overshirt over stone-grey crewneck. SAME exact face as four lower portraits in reference, no blue fur, hoodie, scarf or accessories. Maintain teen peer appeal for ages 13–15, not an elderly professor. Paws have short furry fingers, never hairless human arms.
atlases.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: PRODUCTION transparent sprite atlas for a Swedish live voice tutor web app. Input image is ONLY an identity/material/clothing reference, NOT an edit target or layout reference. Preserve the selected character exactly. Do NOT copy ANY UI, text, captions, pills, icons, borders, graphs or backgrounds.
Output a HIGH RESOLUTION landscape atlas 3840 by 2160 pixels, 4 equally spaced columns and 2 equally spaced rows, each cell exactly 960 by 1080. True TRANSPARENT RGBA background, not a drawn checkerboard, no backdrop, no floor, no shadows or props behind figures. Seven SEPARATE waist-up cutout poses, one centered within each cell. Each figure about 820px tall with 80px clear padding on every side. Consistent head size, head height and eye line across all cells; full ears, both forearms, elbows and every finger entirely visible. ALL silhouettes must stay within their own cell with clear transparent gaps; no overlapping neighbouring cells. EIGHTH cell bottom-right MUST be fully empty transparent. NO TEXT OR LABELS anywhere.
Read poses left-to-right, top row then bottom row:
1 GREETING: warm closed-mouth smile, direct eye contact, both hands open gently at waist in welcome, upright.
2 LISTENING: mouth fully closed, engaged head tilt, eyes towards learner, both hands relaxed open low at waist, subtle asymmetry, no busy gesture.
3 SPEAKING: mouth visibly open mid-sentence, facing learner or slightly viewer LEFT, two natural explanatory OPEN-PALM gestures, not pointing.
4 THINKING: mouth closed, thoughtful eyes toward viewer LEFT where board lives, one hand lightly near chin and other forearm supporting it, not worried or sleepy.
5 WORKING: mouth closed, focused eyes look down slightly viewer LEFT, one hand holds SMALL PLAIN CREAM NOTEPAD and other holds pencil making a mark; notepad does not hide face or hands.
6 WAITING: mouth closed, both hands loosely resting together at waist, shoulders relaxed, eyes open gently directed viewer LEFT or learner, no closed sleepy eyes.
7 POINTING: mouth open mid-explanation, leftmost hand points confidently toward viewer LEFT board with clear index finger, other hand open palm at waist, face looks learner or viewer LEFT. Pointing hand remains inside cell.
8 EMPTY TRANSPARENT.
Gaze NEVER points viewer right/outside screen. Exactly two articulated arms, two expressive anatomically clean hands each with FIVE digits including opposable thumb, fingers naturally posed and no duplicated fingers. Clothing and fur must be identical across seven poses. Grounded adult or teen-compatible proportions, no infant proportions, no exaggerated huge eyes. Premium matte soft 3D illustration consistent with reference. Lower torso ends in a subtle alpha fade below the hands, never fade the hands. True transparent edges with no dark or white matte halo. NO UI, NO bars/waves/icons; app draws the state indicators separately. NO external brand resemblance. This is final reusable character art, not a concept sheet.
IDENTITY TO PRESERVE:
Selected G1 LODJURET, the grey-brown anthro Nordic lynx in the supplied reference: black long ear tufts, warm hazel eyes, cream chin, short lynx muzzle and black nose, grey-brown spotted fur and cheek ruffs. Plain charcoal unfastened overshirt over stone-grey crewneck. SAME exact face as four lower portraits in reference, no blue fur, hoodie, scarf or accessories. Maintain teen peer appeal for ages 13–15, not an elderly professor. Paws have short furry fingers, never hairless human arms.

atlases.name: Björnen
atlases.detail: Selected V3 BJÖRNEN, the mature brown bear colleague in supplied reference. Broad grounded shoulders, kind small amber eyes, broad bear muzzle, warm umber/walnut fur and slightly lighter muzzle, round bear ears, subtle silver near temples. Plain DEEP MOSS rolled-sleeve overshirt over OATMEAL crewneck. SAME exact face as four lower portraits in reference. Both expressive FIVE-DIGIT hands with short fur on backs and warm brown palms, no claws. Reassuring colleague for gymnasiet students and adults, not a plush teddy or aggressive wild bear. No extra clothing or accessories.
